_comment: Personal constants for the networking agent (company-scout, hiring_heat, dashboard). Copy to config/network.json and fill in YOUR details. Everything candidate-specific lives here: the scout agent reads this file instead of hardcoding anyone's profile, so an ML person and a robotics person can share the repo. config/network.json is gitignored.

candidate.headline: Robotics Engineer at Acme Dynamics
candidate.visa_note: needs H1B sponsorship (set to "" if not applicable)
candidate.one_liner: Jane is a robotics engineer at Acme Dynamics. She shipped the SLAM stack on 500+ deployed robots and holds two patents in visual odometry.

resume_core: Languages must include C++, Python. Robotics (when that group is present) must include ROS2, SLAM, motion planning.

outreach.ask_role: Would you be open to referring me for it?
outreach.ask_general: I'd love to be considered as the team grows. Open to a quick 15-minute chat?
outreach.signoff_style: warm and direct, no corporate filler
